create_kaboom.alt_fuze.title: Altitude Fuze
block.create_kaboom.guidance.gps.tooltip: Targets _fixed coordinates_. Right-click the placed unit to set its destination.
block.create_kaboom.guidance.command.too: Targets the linked _Network Controller's target_. Right-click a controller with this unit to pair it before missile assembly. Will not launch without a valid target.
block.create_kaboom.guidance.radar.toolt: Immediately locks on to _radar targets within 15 degrees_ of the launcher,  up to _1000 blocks_ away. Will not launch without a valid target
block.create_kaboom.guidance.arad.toolti: Homes on _radar emitters_. Sneak-right-click the placed unit to switch between manual designation and automatic forward-cone scanning. Will not launch without a valid target.
item.create_kaboom.rocket.guidance.comma: Can be linked manually by right clicking a network controller, or can auto link when fired from a radar controlled mount. Will not fire without a valid target
item.create_kaboom.rocket.guidance.radar: Immediately locks on to _radar targets within 30 degrees_ of the launcher,  up to _500 blocks_ away. Will not fire without a valid target
exception.create_kaboom.cannon_mount.inv: A rocket pod must contain one rear followed by at least one center, with no gaps and no more blocks than CBC's maximum cannon length. A front cap is optional.
exception.create_kaboom.cannon_mount.mis: Rocket pod component at %s, %s, %s is not aligned with the pod.
exception.create_kaboom.cannon_mount.inv: Side rocket pods must be complete, aligned, equally long, and limited to one pod on each side.
A mounted missile must contain a controller thruster, at least one matching fuel tank, one matching guidance unit, and a matching warhead in a straight line.
